name: Are kitchen cabinets installed before or after countertops and tile?

mainEntity.name: Are kitchen cabinets installed before or after countertops and tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinets should always be installed before your countertops and tile backsplash go in. Base cabinets must be set perfectly level and anchored to wall framing to support the heavy weight of stone, quartz, or marble surfaces. Countertop fabricators require fully secured base units before they can take exact laser templates. Your tile backsplash is installed last, resting directly atop the newly fitted counters to ensure clean grout lines and watertight sealing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinets are always installed before countertops and backsplashes. Base units must be level and secured to wall studs so countertops can be measured and supported properly.
